title.sub: Where and when to land at the lunar south pole, checked against NASA data

clips.caption: Moon weather: a month of light and shadow at the south pole, where the Sun stays within about 1.5° of the horizon.
Pick a site and a date: real terrain, real Sun and Earth, time to sunset and Earthset.
A year of dates in one search: 24 Aug 2027 gives 41% Earth contact, 20 Oct the most sunlight.
Published coordinates can be the wrong spot: Malapert's point sees no Earth, the crest 10.7 km east 70% (Nov 2026).
Our shadows against NASA's LRO photos: 5 of 6 frames match, with the pass rule fixed before the run.

end.sub: JPL Horizons agreement 0.04 arcsec · 6 of 7 real landings
